record.notes: Adopted in Paris on 29 May 2026 under the French G7 Presidency. Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications confirms the year and describes the declaration as the meeting's outcome document. Also encourages AI procurement guidelines and support for France's open-source 'Meta-detector' synthetic-content tool. The June 2026 G7 Leaders' Summit outcome on AI was not checked.
